name: tariffmonitor-mcp
description: tariffmonitor-mcp is US import tariff lookup software by 0xpi for AI agents and developers: an MCP server that looks up 19,856 HTS codes and estimates stacked US import duty rates (MFN, Section 301 and Section 232) by country of origin. Free and open source, with a free hosted endpoint. Tariff Exposure Monitor — live US import tariff calculator MCP server. Looks up any HTS code, returns an estimated stacked rate (MFN + Section 301, including the 2026 forced-labor tariff on 60 economies, + Section 232) and states when the Section 301 China exclusions end (11:59 p.m. EDT, 9 Nov 2026 per the Federal Register; USTR's press release says 10 Nov 2026). 19,856 HTS codes. Free hosted remote (no key, 25 calls/IP/day): https://adcreator-ai.com/mcp-free. New in 1.3: compare_origins (CN vs VN vs MX vs IN side by side) and plain-language product lookup (laptop, earbuds, toys). Free, no signup.
author: Dale Weaver
